caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rectangular box with a hinged lid. The box features a marbled pattern in shades of brown, tan, cream, and muted orange, with darker brown borders outlining its edges and creating a frame around the panels. The front panel has a keyhole at its center, indicating a locking mechanism, and the left side panel is fitted with a metallic decorative handle or latch featuring ornate, shield-like detailing. The surface of the box displays a combination of straight and wavy lines, imitating natural wood grain, and the marbled panels have a swirl-like texture. The composition is centered on the page, with the box shown in three-quarter perspective, allowing the front and left side to be visible. The background is a plain, light beige color with faint yellow-orange specks and smudges, and there is a small, handwritten signature on the lower right side of the image.
